baseline: vendor DecisionEngine, first run with the trained mask: the prefix one block and the suffix one block (one branch per forward)

masks.trained_repeat: the trained mask scored a second time: the noise floor
masks.suffix: each prefix token its own block, the suffix one block
masks.prefix: the prefix one block, each suffix token its own block

reference.device: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition

prefix_boundary.rule: the token after the last '</state>\n\n' in the prompt's tokens equals the vendor engine's prefix length
